description_expanded:
WaterColor, steps from Dragonfly Pool

Access to Camp Watercolor and Watercolor Beach Club!

Community pools, seasonally heated

5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths

Open-air front porch

Multiple living spaces with TVs

Quaint outdoor areas, screened porch with fireplace

4 bikes!

615 E Royal Fern Way by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Steps from Dragonfly Pool and minutes to Camp WaterColor, welcome to 615 E Royal Fern Way, a five-bedroom retreat in one of WaterColor’s most loved neighborhoods. A spectacular home, it’s bright, comfortable, and thoughtfully put together, ideal for groups who like things relaxed, with just the right amount of style. As part of WaterColor, guests have access to the Beach Club, featuring multiple pools, generous lounge space, and updated dining options such as the WaterColor Grill and Costa Chica, all designed for sunset views. Getting around is simple, too: four bikes are included! Another home highlight? Out back, the screened porch is beyond charming. Comfortable seating, a dining table, custom fireplace, and a large TV keep the evening going long after dinner. The main level is built for gathering, with lots of room to spread out.

There’s a built-in wet bar with a U-Line wine cooler, and a kitchen that’s ready for real cooking, outfitted with GE Monogram appliances, clean finishes, and space to move around without bumping elbows. Two primary bedrooms are on this floor, each with its own full bathroom. A powder room and laundry area round things out, especially useful after a full day outside. Upstairs, three more bedrooms keep the group close, including a bunk room for four that tends to become the late-night hangout. There’s also a second living space: very adorable and perfect for movies, games, or a quiet break when the day winds down. 615 E Royal Fern is where style meets barefoot ease, a location that makes WaterColor, and 30A, easy. Bring your people and stay a while. Overview: - Access to five WaterColor resort-style pools - 4 bedrooms + bunk room, 4.5 baths - Open and well-equipped chef's kitchen - Screened-in outdoor living space with fireplace - Dining for eight with breakfast bar seating for six - 4 bikes Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: king bed, private bath, double vanity, walk-in shower - Guest Room: king bed, private bath, double vanity, walk-in shower SECOND FLOOR - Guest Room: king bed, private bath - Guest Room: queen bed, shared hall bath - Bunkroom: custom built-in two sets of twin over twin bunk beds, shared hall bath - Second living area with entertainment seating and large TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
